items.name: Spare fuse
items.description: A dry ceramic fuse, rescued from a supply crate.

items.name: Brass key
items.description: The keeper's key to the lantern stairs.

rooms.name: 01 / The Quay
rooms.description: Night is falling. A boat waits beyond the reef, but the lighthouse is dark. Search the supply crate, then find the keeper.

hotspots.label: Search supply crate
hotspots.text: Under a folded oilskin, you find a spare fuse.

hotspots.label: Enter workshop
hotspots.blocked_text: The workshop door will not open.
hotspots.text: Warm lamplight spills from the workshop.

rooms.name: 02 / The Workshop
rooms.description: The keeper studies a chart of the reef. Above the workbench, a locked stairway leads to the lantern.

hotspots.label: Return to quay
hotspots.text: You step back into the salt air.

hotspots.label: Talk to the keeper
hotspots.text: The keeper looks up from the chart.

hotspots.label: Unlock lantern stairs
hotspots.blocked_text: The stairway is locked. Ask the keeper for the brass key.
hotspots.text: The brass key turns. You climb to the lantern.

rooms.name: 03 / The Lantern
rooms.description: The great lens is still. Fit the spare fuse into the dark control panel, then send a signal across the water.

hotspots.label: Fit spare fuse
hotspots.blocked_text: You need the spare fuse from the quay and the keeper's instructions.
hotspots.text: The fuse clicks into place. The lens begins to turn.

hotspots.label: Light the beacon
hotspots.blocked_text: The beacon has no power. Repair the control panel first.
hotspots.text: A ribbon of light sweeps the reef.

nodes.speaker: The keeper
nodes.text: A boat is waiting offshore. Will you help me bring her home?

choices.text: Tell me how to fix the light.

nodes.speaker: The keeper
nodes.text: Take my key. Find the spare fuse in the quay's supply crate and fit it in the lantern panel. Then light the beacon.

choices.text: Take the key. I'll get the light working.

endings.text: The boat answers with two soft bells. Guided by your light, she slips safely into harbor. The keeper waves from the quay. You brought them home. / THE END
